name: identity_resolver
summary: The signal-fusion layer for the morphing-game runtime. Takes a viewer's bearer token + optional platform addresses/handles (Sui, Solana, X, Snap, Facebook) and emits an AudiencePersonaVector — a 32-d float vector plus an inferred_role label that morph_game_runtime uses to decide which scene variant to render for that viewer.
engine_pattern: stateless fusion. resolve(token, extras) verifies the bearer via freetier_gate, fans out to every available connector best-effort under a 2s/probe deadline, computes a deterministic 32-d persona vector, runs the cheap role classifier, crystal-anchors the event, writes a 24h TTL cache, returns the dataclass. NEVER RAISES.

subcommands.resolve: verify + gather + vectorize + role-infer + crystal-anchor + cache; print AudiencePersonaVector JSON
subcommands.infer-role: given a signals_json bundle, just print the inferred_role label (offline, no connector probes)
subcommands.persona-stats: walk ~/.cc/persona_cache/*.json and bucket personas by inferred_role + tier; count stale entries

AudiencePersonaVector: persona_id (sha256 of user_id + accepted_terms_hash + first_seen_ts, 32-char hex prefix)
friends_consent (bool — token claim OR FB connector probe wins)
fb_player_id (str — defaults to claims.user_id if not overridden)

persona_vector_slots_32d.16..31: reserved — zero-padded for future signals (Discord, Telegram, Stripe tier, on-chain reputation, etc.)

substrate: writes ~/.cc/persona_cache/<persona_id>.json (24h TTL) + crystal chain entry (tier='identity_resolution', model='identity_resolver')

env_vars.CC_AGENT_UUID: inherited by InferenceLogger when anchoring the crystal

outbound_calls: core/lib/third_party/solana_mcp.py::SolanaMCPConnector.send('query_balance', ...) (SOL balance + SPL count — parallel agent D building)

graceful_degradation: EVERY connector call is lazy-imported and wrapped in try/except + a 2s POSIX SIGALRM deadline. Missing keys / missing libs / network failures yield zero/empty slots; the rest of the resolution proceeds. resolve() NEVER RAISES.
determinism: persona_id = sha256(user_id|accepted_terms_hash|first_seen_ts)[:32]. stdlib has no blake3 so sha256 is the locked contract — same inputs yield the same persona_id across runs and hosts. first_seen_ts defaults to claims.iat so the id is stable across the token's lifetime.
ttl: persona cache entries are valid for 24h (PERSONA_CACHE_TTL_SECONDS = 86400). persona_stats reports the count of stale entries.
usage_example: python3 core/lib/identity_resolver.py resolve $TOKEN\n# Returns AudiencePersonaVector JSON. inferred_role defaults to 'unknown' when no platform connectors return data.
